## Before filing, if this proposes a quality or craft metric

This project keeps a refutation ledger of every prose-quality proxy it has
tried. Read these first — most metric ideas have already been tried and killed:

- [ ] `research/quality-measurement/BRIEF.md` (the refutation ledger)
- [ ] `research/quality-measurement/EPISTEMIC_GOVERNANCE.md` (what may become evidence)
- [ ] `CONTRIBUTING.md` § "Before proposing a quality or craft metric"

Note the standing scope rule: measurement is LLM-only. Proposals involving
human readers, labels, or panels are out of scope and will be closed.
